about: Shared expectations for clock times with am/pm, said the way people say them ('5pm' five P M, '12 pm' noon, '9am-5pm' nine A M to five P M). Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech / Clock (libs/backseat/backseat_tests/spoken_times.json); 'ayem' and 'peeem' are lexicon stand-ins for A M / P M, so a port compares after mapping them to its own spelling. EpubToM4B can port the rule (books write '5 p.m.', 'six A.M.'); keep both copies in sync.
